title: An ops row of a census phase or of the sync gate written by a probe in another working directory still reaches the owning clone's spool
goal: the guard against a probe's ops row covers every ops row the clone's tools write (ql_capture.record for the ops surface), not only ops_row and record_pipeline, unless the caller names its own query-log home

run:
import os, shutil, subprocess as s, sys, tempfile, pathlib as P
t1 = P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); t2 = P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
shutil.copytree("_tools", t1 / "_tools", ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "test_*"))
for d in (t1, t2):
    s.run(["git", "-C", str(d), "init", "-q"], check=True)
base = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ("PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST", "CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA", "CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT", "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")}
code = "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,%r);import ql_capture;ql_capture.census_phase('verify',lambda t:0,'2026-10-26')" % str(t1 / "_tools")
r = s.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], cwd=t2, env=base, capture_output=True, text=True)
stray = list((t1 / "_cache").rglob("*.jsonl"))
print("rows a census phase run from another directory left in the owning clone's spool:", len(stray), r.stderr[-200:])
sys.exit(0 if not stray else 1)

notes: Found by the SP-vmtfnkim review on 2026-10-26. It changes the provisional answer BG-zoaoahj4 g1 took (the guard in ops_row and record_pipeline only; the other option, a guard in ql_capture.record, was not taken): kg_sync.record_gate (sync.gate) and ql_capture.census_phase (census.phase) call ql_capture.record directly, so a probe that imports the clone's tools from another directory still writes those rows to the clone's spool. The repro runs a census phase from a temporary clone and counts the rows left in the owning clone's spool. The operator decides whether the gate's other option is meant.
